rules: Do not assign a legacy feature number without direct source evidence.
Archive original source artifacts before promoting candidate records to verified historical status when byte-level access is available.
If a source is readable but raw-byte materialization is unavailable, register it separately as a located source and do not claim byte-identical archival or SHA-256 provenance.
Preserve conflicting or overlapping source records until canonical deduplication is independently reviewed.
A source evidence artifact may strengthen provenance without increasing the registry count when its capabilities are already registered.
